APPDEV MASTER RECONCILIATION — 2026-09-24

appDev MASTER is the canonical registry of Apps, Products, Workspaces, Helpers,
Agents, subordinate Helpers, Modules, Capabilities, Providers and relationships.

Canonical registry fields:
canonical_id; canonical_name; symbol; short_form; expanded_name/title;
functional acronym meaning; conceptual meaning; behavioral metaphor/personality;
entity_type; role; purpose; scope; authoritative ownership; capabilities;
boundaries/non-goals; commands/modes; parent/family; subordinates; relationships;
standalone_capable; embedded_capable; provider/execution modes; status;
version/revision; availability; legacy aliases; supersedes/superseded_by;
provenance; confidence; visual metadata.

TYPE = what the thing is.
CAPABILITY = operation.
PROVIDER = implementation.
INSTANCE / CONNECTION = configured installation/account/device.
Provider ≠ connection.

Canonical runtime human-readable identity: APP.SUBORDINATE.
Historical aliases belong in provenance/migration records, not active namespace.
Newest explicit established decisions override older conflicts without destroying provenance.
